description: This file is a Markdown documentation file describing the Java class 'RequestOptions' used in the Playwright testing library. It details the API for creating and configuring request options for HTTP requests within Playwright, including methods for setting headers, data, form data, retries, redirects, etc.

classes.name: RequestOptions
classes.description: A class used to create and configure HTTP request options for the Playwright API. Provides methods for setting request data, headers, form data, multipart data, retries, redirects, timeout, and other request configurations.

methods.name: RequestOptions.create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RequestOptions.

methods.name: RequestOptions.setData
methods.description: Sets the data payload for the request, supporting various data types like string, Buffer, or serializable objects.

methods.name: RequestOptions.setFailOnStatusCode
methods.description: Configures whether to throw an error on non 2xx/3xx HTTP status responses.

methods.name: RequestOptions.setForm
methods.description: Provides a FormData object that will be serialized as 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' payload.

methods.name: RequestOptions.setHeader
methods.description: Sets a custom HTTP header for the request.

methods.name: RequestOptions.setIgnoreHTTPSErrors
methods.description: Specifies whether to ignore HTTPS errors.

methods.name: RequestOptions.setMaxRedirects
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of redirects to follow.

methods.name: RequestOptions.setMaxRetries
methods.description: Configures the maximum number of retries for network errors.

methods.name: RequestOptions.setMethod
methods.description: Sets the HTTP method (e.g., GET, POST, PUT).

methods.name: RequestOptions.setMultipart
methods.description: Provides a FormData object to serialize as 'multipart/form-data'.

methods.name: RequestOptions.setQueryParam
methods.description: Adds a query parameter to the request URL.

methods.name: RequestOptions.setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the request timeout in milliseconds.
